title: MoS Margherita & Bihar Governor Hasnain to attend Khamenei’s funeral in Iran
full_text: MoS Margherita & Bihar Governor Hasnain to attend Khamenei’s funeral in Iran Minister of State for External Affairs Pabitra Margherita and Bihar Governor Lieutenant General (Retired) Syed Ata Hasnain will attend former Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's funeral, who was killed in a US-Israeli operation. Minister of State for External Affairs Pabitra Margherita and Bihar Governor Lieutenant General (Retired) Syed Ata Hasnain will attend former Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s funeral, according to CNN-News 18. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian had invited Prime Minister Narendra Modi to the funeral, and Margherita and Hasnain will be attending in his place. Khamenei was killed on February 28 in the opening salvo of the American-Israeli war on Iran in a strike on a compound in Tehran. At least seven other top Iranian leaders were also killed in the strike. The funeral ceremonies will start on July 4 and conclude on July 9 with burial in Khamenei’s hometown of Mashhad. The funeral was initially supposed to take place in March but was postponed because of the ongoing war that only ebbed in April with a ceasefire between the United States and Iran. As per the Iranian state media, Khamenei’s body will lie in state at the Tehran Mosalla on July 4 and 5. Then, a funeral procession will be held in Tehran on July 6 and another funeral ceremony will take place in Qom, a city holy for Shia Muslims, on July 7. Finally, on June 9, he will be buried at the shrine of the eighth Shia imam in Mashhad following a funeral procession through the city.
